CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hardware_checkout_get(p_client text, p_guest_hash text, p_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('id',o.id,'order_state',o.order_state,'payment_eligible',false,'goods_total_kobo',o.goods_total_kobo,'goods_tax_kobo',o.goods_tax_kobo,'delivery_total_kobo',o.delivery_total_kobo,'payable_total_kobo',o.payable_total_kobo)
 from hardware_orders o join hardware_checkout_receipts r on r.order_id=o.id where o.id=p_id and r.client=p_client and r.guest_hash=p_guest_hash
$function$

relations.name: hardware_checkout_receipts
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER checkout_receipts_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.hardware_checkout_receipts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hardware_order_immutable()
CREATE TRIGGER checkout_receipts_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.hardware_checkout_receipts FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION hardware_order_immutable()
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES hardware_orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
